description: Type, read and hear the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) with NVDA. Press NVDA+Alt+I and your normal keys type IPA symbols, with each symbol named as you type it. NVDA says IPA symbols by name in every program. Press Space after a transcription to hear it as a real word, through eSpeak or IBM TTS. Turn on fluent reading with NVDA+Alt+F to hear the transcriptions in a document as words. Learn it all by ear with the trainer: press NVDA+Alt+P, or use Tools in the NVDA menu. Covers British English (RP) and supports American English.
changelog: First release in the NVDA Add-on Store.
